step_free_route.title: Step-free route
step_free_route.summary: Finds a route from the entrance to each room and marks steps and narrow points on it.

turning_space.title: Turning space
turning_space.summary: Checks whether each room has a clear 1.5 m turning circle.

bathroom_clearance.title: Bathroom clearance
bathroom_clearance.summary: Checks bathroom floor space and door swing for a wheelchair.

record_vs_reality.title: Record versus reality
record_vs_reality.summary: Compares the listing or CoStar record with what the scan measured: rooms, areas, features.

daylight.title: Daylight
daylight.summary: Estimates daylight per room from window area and orientation.

furniture_fit.title: Furniture fit
furniture_fit.summary: Tests whether a box of given size passes along the route to a room and fits inside it.

stairs_count.title: Stairs
stairs_count.summary: Counts floors and stairs between the entrance and bedrooms.

unit_compare.title: Unit compare
unit_compare.summary: Ranks several units side by side on the metrics you care about.

fire_preplan.title: Fire pre-plan
fire_preplan.summary: Builds a pre-incident plan: entries, egress, hazards, utilities and access for apparatus.

egress_routes.title: Egress routes
egress_routes.summary: Traces the exit path from every room and its narrowest point.

flood_rehearsal.title: Flood rehearsal
flood_rehearsal.summary: Shows what a given water depth would reach, room by room, from ground elevation.

valuables_height.title: Valuables height
valuables_height.summary: Lists what sits below a water line and where higher ground inside is.

roof_facts.title: Roof facts
roof_facts.summary: Roof shape, material, condition and solar from aerial imagery.

office_fit.title: Office fit
office_fit.summary: Estimates desks and meeting rooms the plan holds for a team size.

truck_access.title: Truck access
truck_access.summary: Checks the approach and turning room for a truck from aerial imagery.

loading_docks.title: Loading docks
loading_docks.summary: Finds loading docks and dock doors from aerial and scan data.

room_labeller.title: Room labeller
room_labeller.summary: Labels unlabelled rooms from panoramas and the corrections you have made.

kids_fit.title: Kids fit
kids_fit.summary: Whether a home suits young children: stairs, the pool path, window falls, a yard seen from the kitchen, playgrounds and schools nearby.

home_search.title: Home search by pets, kids and places nearby
home_search.summary: Find homes across a city by pet policy, fenced yard, pool, and distance to playgrounds, parks and dog parks.
